text: RobustLeastSquares is now a first-class row-wise robust GLM engine aligned with fmrireg semantics: Huber/bisquare/disabled paths run through FitInterpreter, diagnostics carry typed RobustWeightTopology.RowWise, scale-scope components, final weights, convergence and delta state, chunked execution prepares full-selection robust weights once and applies them in parallel voxel chunks, and robust dense fits keep shared covariance for contrast inference. Added fmrireg robust fixtures for run-scope Huber coefficients/weights and voxel scale components. Verification: sbt fitJVM/test passed 108 tests; sbt fitJS/test passed 105 tests; scoped diff/whitespace checks clean.
